name: Lohith B.
headline: IT Consultant | Enterprise Outreach | SaaS | Cloud | ERP | Enterprise Integration |Data & Analytics Solutions | Enterprise Technology | Infrastructure | CyberSecurity

experiences.description:
- Executed multi-channel outbound prospecting across the US(Pacific, Central) through cold calls, targeted email campaigns, and LinkedIn outreach, generating a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities. 

- Built and expanded target account lists by onboarding 10–15 new enterprise accounts weekly, mapping CXO, VP, and Director-level stakeholders to strengthen account penetration. 

- Leveraged LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, SalesIntel, and Indeed to gather prospect intelligence and personalize outreach. 

- Delivered high-volume outreach with 80–100+ calls and emails daily, combining scale with tailored messaging based on prospect IT environments. 

- Initiated strategic conversations with CXOs, IT leaders, and business stakeholders, uncovering challenges across enterprise technology landscapes. 

- Qualified opportunities by aligning needs with solutions across ERP (Oracle EBS, NetSuite), Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Data & Analytics (Tableau, Power BI), Integration (Boomi, MuleSoft), Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and CRM (Salesforce). 

- Positioned value-driven offerings around implementation, modernization, and managed services, supporting digital transformation initiatives. 

- Collaborated with technical teams to facilitate demos, solution alignment, and proposal development. 
Maintained accurate pipeline tracking and reporting in Salesforce CRM. 
.

- Delivered market research reports and advisory solutions to business clients, students, and individual buyers across the US and EMEA regions. 
- Handled end-to-end sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure, in a target-driven environment. 
- Converted inbound and outbound leads through consistent follow-ups and requirement-based recommendations. 
- Drove revenue through upselling and cross-selling reports based on client needs and industry relevance. 
- Closed high-value deals by clearly communicating the business value of market insights. 
- Worked closely with internal teams to ensure the timely delivery of reports and a smooth customer experience. 
- Maintained and tracked sales activities, deals, and revenue pipelines in CRM.

- Managed inbound and outbound sales across the EMEA region, engaging with students, job seekers, and working professionals seeking to upskill in real-time. 
- Executed multi-channel outreach including cold calls, email campaigns, and structured follow-ups, generating and nurturing a strong pipeline of qualified prospects. 
- Conducted consultative discussions to understand career goals and skill gaps, recommending 
relevant upskilling programs aligned to industry demands. 
- Consistently followed up with prospects through personalized engagement strategies, improving conversion rates and deal closures. 
- Identified and pursued new sales opportunities across both B2C and B2B segments, expanding market reach. 
- Closed high-value (big-ticket) deals by effectively handling objections and aligning program value with customer outcomes. 
- Collaborated with internal teams to support end-to-end sales cycle execution, from lead generation to closure. 
- Maintained accurate tracking of leads, interactions, and sales pipeline within CRM systems.

- Led B2B sales initiatives for K-12 classroom technology solutions, focusing on digital infrastructure and smart learning environments for schools. 
- Engaged directly with school management, principals, and administrative decision-makers to present and demonstrate classroom technology solutions. 
- Navigated institutional buying processes involving budget approvals, multiple stakeholders, and longer sales cycles. 
- Conducted in-person and virtual meetings to understand school requirements and propose 
customized technology setups. 
- Drove deal closures for high-value institutional contracts, aligning solutions with academic and operational needs. 
- Built trust-based relationships with schools, contributing to repeat engagements and referrals within the education network. 
- Worked closely with internal teams for solution deployment planning and post-sale coordination.

- Managed high-volume B2C sales for digital learning solutions, engaging with students and parents through both inside and field sales channels. 
- Conducted detailed counselling sessions to understand student learning needs, academic goals, and parent expectations, recommending suitable learning programs. 
- Handled end-to-end sales cycle including lead engagement, product demonstration, objection handling, and deal closure. 
- Worked in a fast-paced, target-driven environment, consistently achieving monthly sales and revenue goals. 
- Built trust with parents by clearly communicating product value, learning outcomes, and long-term benefits. 
- Managed a large volume of leads and follow-ups, ensuring timely engagement and improved conversion rates. 
- Adapted sales approach across diverse customer segments, improving conversion efficiency and customer satisfaction. 
- Collaborated with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and post-sale customer experience.
